title: How this blog works
description: Posts are JSON files edited through the CMS. The file name becomes the address of the page.
author: Aaron Garcia
body:
## One file per post

Every post lives in `src/lib/content/blog/`. The name of the file is its slug, so `how-this-blog-works.json` is served at `/blog/how-this-blog-works`.

## Editing

Open `/admin`, choose **Blog**, and write. A new post gets its file name from its title when it is first saved. Changing the title later does not move the page, so links keep working.

> Tick **Draft** to keep a post hidden while you work on it.

## Formatting

You can use *italics*, **bold**, lists, links and headings, with all the usual Markdown.
